source.content: public class LocalFinalizer implements Finalizer { public static String observed = ''; public void execute(FinalizerContext ctx) { observed = ctx.getResult().name() + ':' + ctx.getRequestId() + ':' + String.valueOf(ctx.getException()); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeFinalizerContextContractsTest { @isTest static void contextGettersAndInterfaceDispatch() { FinalizerContext fc = new FinalizerContext(); System.assertEquals('', fc.getRequestId()); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', fc.getResult().name()); System.assertEquals(null, fc.getException()); System.FinalizerContextImpl fci = new System.FinalizerContextImpl(); System.assertEquals('', fci.getRequestId()); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', fci.getResult().name()); System.assertEquals(null, fci.getException()); new LocalFinalizer().execute(fc); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS::null', LocalFinalizer.observed); } }
